criteria.criterion: independently reproducible raw capture with known generator bytes; verdicts; no STOP.txt; zero error-scan matches
criteria.new_evidence: Instrument SHA-256 B5D58F7F… reported; published instrument is 85AC7271… (10,231 B LF, blob eaea3f7f…). No STOP.txt; zero error-scan matches.
criteria.substantive_finding: NOT ESTABLISHED. The reported digest does not match the published instrument, so the generator is a different or modified script whose scope/safety/STOP semantics cannot be independently checked until its bytes are supplied. The published instrument defines Stop-Report but never calls it, so absence of STOP.txt is not a positive verdict. A limited error-pattern scan with zero matches does not evaluate PF-01…PF-17.

exit_signals_not_proof.no_stop_txt: The published instrument never calls its Stop-Report function; a missing STOP.txt is expected regardless of unobserved criteria. It is not evidence of a pass.
exit_signals_not_proof.zero_error_scan_matches: A limited pattern scan over a transcript cannot establish PF-01…PF-17; zero matches means no matched error strings, not that every acceptance condition was evaluated and passed.
exit_signals_not_proof.corrected_ancestor_traversal: Reaching C:\ without errors evidences walkability, not the absence of .git markers or the local/NTFS/non-sync predicates, unless the raw transcript says so.
exit_signals_not_proof.capture_completion: Capture files existing is not acceptance (§16.148, §16.149.8).
